hero.source: Isle of Skye UK relief location map
hero.description:
Relief map of the Isle of Skye, UK.
Equirectangular map projection on WGS 84 datum, with N/S stretched 180%
Geographic limits:

West: 6.85W
East: 5.5W
North: 57.8N
South: 57.0N
categories: Maps of the Isle of Skye
